description_en: Retrieves the list of versions for a resource export task
description_zh: 获取资源导出任务版本列表
name: ListResourceExportTaskVersions

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. Fuzzy search on export version names is supported
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，支持对导出版本名称的模糊搜索
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource export task
parameters.name: export_task_id

parameters.help_en: The number of results per page. Default value: 20. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的结果数量。默认值：20，最小值：1，最大值：100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The export status. Valid values:

Queue: queued
Pending: preparing to run
Success: succeeded
Errored: failed
Canceled: canceled
parameters.help_zh:
导出状态

Queue：排队中
Pending：准备运行
Success：运行成功
Errored：运行错误
Canceled：被取消
parameters.name: status

exportTasks.description_en: The list of export task versions

items.description_en: The list of export task versions

createTime.description_en: The creation time in UTC, in the ISO 8601 format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
createTime.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

exportTaskId.description_en: The ID of the resource export task

exportToModule.description_en: The module to which the exported template is saved. If this parameter is not set, the template is automatically saved in the Registry
exportToModule.description_zh: 将导出后的模板保存为Module。 如果未设置，那么将自动保存在Registry中

source.description_en:
The module type to which the exported template is saved. Valid values:

OSS: OSS
Registry: Terraform Registry
source.description_zh:
导出后的模板保存的Module类型。可选值：

OSS ：OSS
Registry: Terraform Registry

sourcePath.description_en:
The path where the template content is saved.

If Source is set to Registry, the format is: "cloudregistry::iacservice//"

If Source is set to OSS, the format is: "oss::https://.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/xxx.zip"
sourcePath.description_zh:
保存模板内容的路径值

当 Source 为 Registry 时，格式为： "cloudregistry::iacservice//"

当 Source 为 OSS 时，格式为："oss::https://.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/xxx.zip"

statePath.description_en: The path of the State file corresponding to the module
statePath.description_zh: Module 对应的State文件的路径值

failedReason.description_en: The reason for the export failure

includeRules.description_en: The list of include rules used when exporting resources
includeRules.description_zh: 导出资源时使用的包含规则列表

items.description_en: The list of include rules used when exporting resources
items.description_zh: 导出资源时使用的包含规则列表

key.description_en:
The name of the include rule for resource export. Valid values:

ResourceType: required. The resource type. Example: ALIYUN::VPC::VPC.
RegionId: required. The region to which the resource belongs. Only one region is supported. Example: cn-chengdu.
\<ResourceType>:Id: the resource ID. Example: ALIYUN::VPC::VPC:Id.
ResourceGroupId: the resource group ID. Example: rg-1234.
ZoneId: the zone to which the resource belongs. Only one zone is supported. Example: cn-hangzhou-h.

Multiple filter conditions have an AND relationship by default. A resource must meet all filter conditions to be considered a match
key.description_zh:
资源导出时的包含规则名称。可选值如下：

ResourceType：必填，资源类型，例如：ALIYUN::VPC::VPC
RegionId：必填，资源所属Region，当前只支持一个Region，例如：cn-chengdu
\<ResourceType>:Id：资源ID,例如：ALIYUN::VPC::VPC:Id
ResourceGroupId：资源组ID，例如：rg-1234
ZoneId：资源所属Zone，目前只支持一个Zone，例如：cn-hangzhou-h

多个过滤条件之间默认是与的关系，即必须符合所有过滤条件，才视为匹配过滤条件

values.description_en: The values of the include rule for resource export
values.description_zh: 一组资源导出时的包含规则的值

items.description_en: The values of the include rule for resource export
items.description_zh: 一组资源导出时的包含规则的值

modules.description_en: The module configuration of the exported resources

source.description_en: The module type where the exported template is located. Two formats are supported: CloudRegistry and OSS. If the ExportToModule parameter is specified, both formats are returned. Otherwise, only CloudRegistry is returned
source.description_zh: 导出后的模板所在的Module类型，目前有两种格式：CloudRegistry 和OSS。如果客户指定了参数 ExportToModule，那么这两种都将返回，否则只返回 CloudRegistry

sourcePath.description_en:
The download address of the exported template within the module.

If Source is CloudRegistry, the format is: "cloudregistry::iacservice//"

当 Source 为 OSS 时，格式为："oss::https://.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/xxx.zip"
